commits.subject: Keep xxl-job integration tests compatible with 3.5.0
Keep xxl-job integration tests compatible with 3.5.0

diagnoses.analysis: The required-status-check is an aggregate gate, not an independent build failure. Its frozen log runs exit 1, and .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-92 explicitly fails when needs.test-latest-deps.result is not success. The only other frozen failed key is testLatestDeps1. The candidate fixes that upstream xxl-job compilation failure; no weakening of the status gate is needed.

The PR changes the pinned com.xuxueli:xxl-job-core latest version from 3.4.2 to 3.5.0. The existing xxlJob33Test imports com.xxl.job.core.openapi.model.TriggerRequest, but 3.5.0 moves it to com.xxl.job.core.openapi.executor.dto.TriggerRequest. The frozen three compiler errors were reproduced locally with pinned latest dependencies. The candidate resolves the version-specific request class reflectively and retains the 3.3.0 baseline. Agent-backed validation then exposed new 3.5.0 executor startup requirements: nonempty admin address, app name and access token, plus a writable log path. The fixture now supplies a real local admin response server, test-only configuration and coordinated local ports, with server teardown. Full affected component checks passed against baseline and latest dependencies on supported JDK 24.
